_comment: Minimum LINE coverage (%) per module and for the merged total, enforced by scripts/coverage-summary.py in CI.
JVM floors = floor(measured) - 1, measured with scripts/jvm-test.sh on af9c1e2 (2026-09-23).
Android modules (core-telephony, core-index, app) and the total (which includes them) start at 0: they cannot
be measured without the Android SDK; raise them to floor(measured) - 1 after the first CI run.
Only ever raise a floor, or lower it with a reason in the commit message. See docs/testing.md.
